## Comparison to ebird data

```{r}
#| label: ebird comparison
#| message: false
#| warning: false

species_ebird <- ncos_ebird %>% 
  filter(category == "species") %>% 
  filter(observation_date > "2017-09-25") %>% 
  pull(common_name) %>% 
  unique()

species_monthly_surveys <- data %>% 
  filter(category == "species") %>% 
  pull(species) %>% 
  unique()

#what species are in ebird that are NOT in monthly surveys
setdiff(species_ebird, species_monthly_surveys)

#what species are in our monthly surveys but not in ebird (probably nothing!)
setdiff(species_monthly_surveys, species_ebird)

#one species! common gull. Maybe mis-identified?
```


## Species composition over time

The lowest richness occurs at survey year 1 with the following years appearing more similar.

```{r}
#| label: fig-bar
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-cap: Species richness per survey year at NCOS. The lowest richness occurs at survey year 1 with the rest appearing more similar.

# notably, no "spuh" category observations

richness <- data %>% 
  filter(!survey_year == 9, category == "species") %>% 
  group_by(survey_year) %>% 
  summarise(n = length(unique(species)))

ggplot(richness,
       aes(x = factor(survey_year),
           y = n,
           fill = survey_year)) + 
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(x = survey_year, y = n + 5, label = n)) + 
  theme_classic() + 
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "C",
                       alpha = 0.85,
                       end = 0.9) + 
  labs(title = "Species Richness by Survey Year",
       x = "Survey Year",
       y = "Number of Species Detected") + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 14),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
        legend.position = "none") + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0),
                     breaks = seq(0,200, by = 25),
                     limits = c(0,150))

```

```{r}

ebird_sy <- ncos_ebird %>% # sy = survey year
  mutate(survey_year = case_when(
      observation_date >= as.Date("2017-09-01") & observation_date <= as.Date("2018-08-31") ~ 1,
      observation_date >= as.Date("2018-09-01") & observation_date <= as.Date("2019-08-31") ~ 2,
      observation_date >= as.Date("2019-09-01") & observation_date <= as.Date("2020-08-31") ~ 3,
      observation_date >= as.Date("2020-09-01") & observation_date <= as.Date("2021-08-31") ~ 4,
      observation_date >= as.Date("2021-09-01") & observation_date <= as.Date("2022-08-31") ~ 5,
      observation_date >= as.Date("2022-09-01") & observation_date <= as.Date("2023-08-31") ~ 6,
      observation_date >= as.Date("2023-09-01") & observation_date <= as.Date("2024-08-31") ~ 7,
      observation_date >= as.Date("2024-09-01") & observation_date <= as.Date("2025-08-31") ~ 8,
      .default = NA))

ebird_richness <- ebird_sy %>% 
  filter(category == "species",
         !is.na(survey_year)) %>% 
  group_by(survey_year) %>% 
  summarize(richness = length(unique(common_name)))

ggplot(ebird_richness,
       aes(x = survey_year,
           y = richness,
           fill = survey_year)) + 
  geom_col() + 
  geom_text(aes(x = survey_year,
                y = richness + 7,
                label = richness)) + 
  theme_classic() + 
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "C",
                  alpha = 0.85,
                  end = 0.9) + 
  labs(title = "eBird NCOS Detected Species Richness vs Survey Year",
       x = "Survey Year",
       y = "Species Richness") + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  size = 14,
                                  face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
        legend.position = "none") + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1,8,by = 1)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0),
                     breaks = seq(0,225,by = 25),
                     limits = c(0,225))

```

```{r}

richness_composite <- inner_join(richness,ebird_richness) %>% 
  mutate(diff = richness - n)

ggplot(richness_composite,
       aes(x = survey_year,
           y = diff,
           fill = survey_year)) + 
  geom_col() + 
  geom_text(aes(x = survey_year,
                y = diff + 5,
                label = diff)) + 
  theme_classic() + 
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "C",
                       alpha = 0.85,
                       end = 0.9) + 
  labs(title = "Difference in NCOS Species Richness Between eBird and CCBER",
       x = "Survey Year",
       y = "Species Richness Difference (eBird - CCBER)") + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 10),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 9),
        legend.position = "none") + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1,8,by = 1)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0),
                     breaks = seq(0,100,by = 20),
                     limit = c(0,100))

```

```{r}
#| label: fig-nmds
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-cap: Revised NMDS based on 'Maximum Species Abundance' of each species in each year. I reproduced it thinking that with cleaner data it might appear differently, giving insight into species identity similarities or differences, following the bar chart of species richness. The usage of setdiff() may be more desirable in this situation.
#| include: false

year_max <- data %>% 
  filter(!survey_year == 9) %>%
  group_by(survey_year, species) %>%
  summarise(max_count = max(count))

community <- as.matrix(unclass(xtabs(max_count ~ survey_year + species,
                                     data = year_max)))

nmds <- metaMDS(community,autotransform = F,distance = "bray",engine = "monoMDS",
                 k = 2,weakties = T,model = "global",maxit = 300,try = 40,
                 trymax = 100,trace = F)

nmds_site_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(nmds)$sites) %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "survey_year") %>% 
  mutate(survey_year = as.numeric(survey_year)) %>% 
  arrange(survey_year) %>% 
  mutate(
    xend = lead(NMDS1),
    yend = lead(NMDS2))

ggplot() + 
  geom_point(data = nmds_site_scores,
                      aes(x = NMDS1,
                          y = NMDS2,
                          color = survey_year),
             size = 3) + 
  geom_segment(data = nmds_site_scores,
               aes(x = NMDS1,
                   y = NMDS2,
                   xend = xend,
                   yend = yend,
                   color = survey_year),
                   arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25,"cm"))) + 
  annotate("text",
           x = -0.2,
           y = 0.15,
           label = paste("2D stress =",
                         round(nmds$stress,3))) + 
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "C",
                        alpha = 0.8,
                        end = 0.95) + 
  theme_light() + 
  labs(title = "Maximum Species Abundance by Survey Year NMDS",
       color = "Survey Year") + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

```



```{r}
#| include: false
#| # TODO- this chunk was a rough attempt at creating an NMDS based on presence-absence (really presence vs. non-detection) of species rather than abundance.

nmds_binary <- metaMDS(community,autotransform = T, distance = "jaccard",engine = "monoMDS",
                 k = 2,weakties = T,model = "global",maxit = 300,try = 40,
                 trymax = 100,trace = F)

nmds_site_scores_binary <- as.data.frame(scores(nmds_binary)$sites) %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "survey_year") %>% 
  mutate(survey_year = as.numeric(survey_year)) %>% 
  arrange(survey_year) %>% 
  mutate(
    xend = lead(NMDS1),
    yend = lead(NMDS2))

ggplot() + 
  geom_point(data = nmds_site_scores_binary,
                      aes(x = NMDS1,
                          y = NMDS2,
                          color = survey_year),
             size = 3) + 
  geom_segment(data = nmds_site_scores_binary,
               aes(x = NMDS1,
                   y = NMDS2,
                   xend = xend,
                   yend = yend,
                   color = survey_year),
                   arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25,"cm"))) + 
  annotate("text",
           x = -0.2,
           y = 0.15,
           label = paste("2D stress =",
                         round(nmds_binary$stress,3))) + 
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "C",
                        alpha = 0.8,
                        end = 0.95) + 
  theme_light() + 
  labs(title = "NMDS based on Jaccard distance (presence/absence)",
       color = "Survey Year") + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
```
